title: Prefill+Decode Concurrency Sweep: Holistic Benchmark Harness and CI Gate
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a reproducible, end-to-end benchmark harness that exercises prefill and decode concurrently under jittered arrival patterns, evaluates per-kernel plumbing and attention optimizations, and produces golden baselines with cohort-aware CI perf gates. Aim is to catch regression modes that only appear when prefill + decode interleave across kernels (KV cache thrash, kernel handoff latencies, attention-window path divergence).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Harness can run synthetic traces with configurable prefill:decode ratios and concurrency up to 256 concurrent sessions on CI-like testbed
A2: Collects per-kernel latency and tail metrics (p50/p95/p99) plus KV cache hit/miss rates and decode stall counts and persists a reproducible golden snapshot
A3: CI perf gate evaluates delta against golden snapshot per cohort and fails with actionable regression metadata (affected kernel, sequence-length cohort, pref/dec concurrency)
A4: Provides automation to lock/unlock golden snapshots and annotate rollouts with canary comparisons
A5: Documentation + runbook and example dashboard link added to PR and Confluence
proposed_design: Design 1: Traffic synthesizer that replays a mix of live-trace-derived prefill/decode sequences with configurable inter-arrival jitter and user think-time
Design 2: Kernel plumbing probe inserted in runtime to stamp events at kernel entry/exit, KV cache operations, and attention-path selection; minimal sampling to bound overhead
Design 3: Cohort partitioning by model family, max-seq, and prompt token distribution to compute cohort-specific golden thresholds
Design 4: Golden snapshot storage in S3 with lockfile semantics and automatic versioning; CI job downloads latest golden and computes percentile diffs
benchmarking_plan: Step 1: Implement traffic synthesizer library and CLI to emit scenario files (JSON) describing prefill/decode mixes
Step 2: Hook lightweight kernel probes and KV cache counters into runtime telemetry; export as OTLP traces + custom metrics
Step 3: Create golden snapshot generator that runs deterministic seed workloads on a pinned infra image and captures metrics
Step 4: Run distributed stability sweep across candidate kernels (triton/cuBLAS/custom kernels) and quantization profiles to map performance surface
Step 5: Surface per-kernel regression attribution via a diff matrix and rank top-3 suspect kernels per regression event
ci_gate_spec: Gate runs on nightly and on PRs that touch runtime/kernel routing or scheduler code
Gate computes cohort-aware p95 and p99 deltas; default fail threshold is 7% p95 increase or 10% p99 increase for high-impact cohorts
When gate fails, CI posts a triage comment with the regression matrix and links to the failure dashboard and suggested rollback commit (if available)
Gate supports a temporary greenlist to allow known flaky kernels for one cycle and requires owner approval to persist
instrumentation_and_logging: Event stamps: kernel_start, kernel_end, kv_get, kv_set, attention_dispatch, prefill_start, decode_start
Compact trace format to avoid perturbing tails; sampling rate tuned during calibration runs
Emit tags for model_id, kernel_variant, seq_length_bin, batch_size, and host_id
Integration with Console ingestion so results can be visualized by route/model and cohort
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Probing overhead corrupts tail metrics; Mitigation: micro-benchmark probe overhead and apply correction factors and low-rate sampling
Risk: Golden snapshot environmental drift (driver/library versions); Mitigation: pin infra image + record ABI/driver manifests in snapshot metadata
Risk: CI compute cost explosion for wide sweeps; Mitigation: tiered sweep: smoke -> focused per-kernel -> full sweep on schedule
Risk: False positives from transient infra noise; Mitigation: require sustained regressions over N runs or combine with production canary data

2025-03-04 - Aisha Kumar: Drafted CI gate thresholds and posted Confluence draft http://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Prefill+Decode+Harness. Feedback: increase p99 threshold sensitivity for high-impact cohorts. Next: finalize gate logic and add dashboard widgets.
